brief:
Create an A3 poster for the Eastbank lantern walk.
Write the email invitation for the same lantern walk.
Put “Free entry; book a place first” on both pieces.
Leave a blank strip along the poster’s bottom edge for partner stickers.
The email must use a single “Reserve a place” link and have no attachments.
We will approve the work on Wednesday; send invoices to the treasurer.
Show the sponsor logo only on the small version.
